scope: local processes inside the Union Officer Academy enterprise

transport.request: one UTF-8 JSON-RPC 2.0 request on standard input followed by EOF
transport.response: one UTF-8 JSON-RPC 2.0 response on standard output followed by process exit

methodMapping.SendMessage: invoke one bounded formation MAPE contribution and return SendMessageResponse.task

serviceParameters.A2A-Version: fixed to 1.0 by this binding carrier and every AgentInterface

dataModel.partDiscriminator: member presence; structured parts use data plus mediaType without legacy kind

errors: invalid carriers terminate nonzero; the calling Academy boundary converts member failure into a typed ActivityStreams Reject
authority: the binding conveys no authority; the enclosing chain-group contract and boundary capability do
